correctness.rationale: Proved for every p>=1 and positive strengths. Fourier spectrum 0..8, finite-rank BS and staggered resolvent identify above-band eigenmodes; BS strict Loewner decrease ensures single crossings. Two-dimensional diagonal Green divergence gives one divergent rank-one branch; finite compression has exactly the resistance matrix on the zero-sum space, and Sylvester inertia yields one plus positive eigenvalues with strict equality. Endpoint Green differences converge by dominated convergence; corner compressed eigenvalues 1/pi and (pi-1)/(3pi) computed explicitly. Executed 23 independent finite-volume / Fourier checks from the actual standalone script. No claim finite checks prove infinity.
